rations 400s from any MCP or built-in tool)
# dsh-gemini-tool-schema
> Normalize the tool schemas sent to the model into the **strict OpenAPI 3.0 subset that Gemini's fu
nction declarations accept**. A TypeScript plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
English | 中文
## The problem
Strict providers accept only a *subset* of JSON Schema. Google Gemini's `functionDeclarations[].para
meters` rejects the **whole request** (HTTP 400) when:
| Real error | Offending schema | Source |
| `schema didn't specify the schema type field` | `{ anyOf: [{type:'string',…}, {type:'null'}] }` —

no `type` | Playwright MCP `browser_emulate_media.colorScheme` (`z.string().nullable()`) |
| `proper
ties[v_types].items: missing field` | `{ type: 'array' }` — no `items` | Lingshu MCP `lingshu_cg` /

`lingshu_stg` (19 params) |
| `properties[permission].enum[3]: cannot be empty` | `enum: [..., '']`
| DSH built-in `task_board_update.permission` |
All three are legal elsewhere, which is why the failure only shows up on a Gemini-flavoured route.
## Why a Harness hook
An MCP proxy only reaches the servers it wraps. Built-in tools and tools registered by other plugins
never cross an MCP transport, so normalizing at Harness assembly time is the only fix that covers *
*every** tool at once.

[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or `npm install dsh-gemini-tool-schema` and mount it by package name.
## Configuration
| Field | Default | Meaning |

| `mode` | `list` | `all` every request · `list` matching APIs only · `off` disabled |
| `apis` | `[

'gemini','google','vertex']` | API patterns, **compiled as regular expressions** |
| `unknownApi` |

`apply` | When the route cannot be read: `apply` or `skip` |
| `itemsFallback` | `{type:'string'}` |

Element schema for arrays that omit `items` |
| `nullable` | `true` | Emit `nullable: true` for nul

l unions |
| `dryRun` | `false` | Report and lint, but send the original schemas |
| `logFile` / `lo

gLevel` | none / `info` | One diagnostic line per assembly |
| `dumpDir` / `dumpSchemas` | none / `t
rue` | Dump the model-facing tool set for offline auditing |
Patterns match against `provider/model` (e.g. `gemini-lumiya/gemini-4-argon`) and accept substring,
regex, and `/pattern/flags` forms; an entry that does not compile degrades to a case-insensitive sub
string match. `'*'` matches everything, or set `mode: all`.
## Rules
Every node gets a `type`; every array gets `items`; `enum` entries are never empty (and `const` cann
ot reintroduce one); `$ref`/`$defs` are inlined cycle-safely; unsupported keywords are stripped and
the remaining scalars pass an allow-list; `required` is narrowed to real properties.
